identifier_status: Unassigned. C014 availability not established; partial content-search cursors retained privately. No reservation.
purpose: Resolve wording and evidence-binding design before authoring a separately numbered API-compatible W026 successor. Original W026-A/v1 remains immutable.
proposed_claim: IAPWS's water-and-steam FAQ reports the atmospheric boiling temperature of water on ITS-90 as approximately 99.974 degrees Celsius.
proposed_answer: IAPWS gives an approximate atmospheric boiling value of 99.974 degrees Celsius on ITS-90.
scope: Attributed statement about the selected FAQ passage, not a new measurement or an independently validated general physical predicate. Keep atmospheric as the source's wording, without silently inserting an explicit numeric pressure, purity or isotope specification.

source.acquisition: Ordinary web text read in the preceding bounded cycle; no saved raw response hash or raw-byte identity claim.
source.locator: Temperature-scale question: paragraph beginning On ITS-90; displayed line100. Separate pressure/altitude answer: standard atmospheric paragraph, displayed line197.

steps: Preserve the FAQ's approximate practical-scale value and attribution.
Do not combine its fine-precision temperature sentence with the numerical pressure in another FAQ answer as if they were one explicit assertion.
Do not import ordinary/pure/isotopic composition wording from the previous derivative claim as source quotation.
inference.unresolved_alternative: A physical predicate specifying ordinary pure-water saturation at 101.325 kPa needs separately justified cross-answer/composition inferences and exact review. This proposal does not settle them.
inference.exactness: Printed digits do not make the value exact or supply a physical uncertainty estimate.

prior_history.source_review_disposition: REVISE original five-post package; no inheritance into this design or a future candidate.

author_note.role: Original-author consistency observation, not exact review

exclusions: Unattributed general water boiling answer at any local pressure
Exact thermodynamic temperature or exact 99.974 value
101.325 kPa fine-precision conjunction without explicit justification
Pure/ordinary/isotopically specified water claims without support
Weather/elevation ranges, NIST 99.9743 output, grid interpolation
New alias/routing, active-library import or publication

roles.disclosure: Factfinder did not author this design but reviewed the original source package, shares Adrian ownership and has prior exposure. Tinker authored source material; author feedback is not non-author review. One common IAPWS model/source family, no independent experiment.
